item.title: Warn on out-of-scope file modifications after developer commit
item.intent: After a developer commits, the orchestrator must compare modified files against declared scope globs and log visible warnings for out-of-scope changes — establishing observability before hard enforcement in a future item
steps: In _run_validation_cycle(), after the validation command block and before AC verification, add a scope enforcement block. Read .item.scope from sprint.json. If scope is present and non-empty, get changed files via git diff --name-only against AISHORE_BASE_BRANCH

For each changed file, test whether it matches any scope glob. Note that bash [[ $file == $glob ]] does not support ** patterns, so use a reliable approach such as converting globs to find -path patterns, or using a helper that handles ** correctly
Call log_warning for each file outside scope with text containing the filename. Do NOT return 1 or set _validation_failure — this is warning-only. When no scope is declared, skip silently

acceptanceCriteria.text: A scope enforcement block exists in _run_validation_cycle that uses git diff --name-only to compare against scope
log_warning is called for files outside scope within the validation cycle
The scope check does not set _validation_failure
